['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nset +e\n\nAPT_MIRROR="http://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/debian"\nAPT_SECURITY_MIRROR="http://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/debian-security"\nUV_INDEX_URL="https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple"\n\nif [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]; then\n    cp /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.bak || true\n    sed -i \\\n        -e "s|http://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|http://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        /etc/apt/sources.list\nfi\n\nif [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]; then\n    cp /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources.bak || true\n    sed -i \\\n        -e "s|http://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|http://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources\nfi\n\nmkdir -p /root/.config/uv\ncat > /root/.config/uv/uv.toml <<EOF\nindex-url = "${UV_INDEX_URL}"\nEOF\n\napt-get update || true\ntrue', 'Enter']

['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nawk -F, \'NR==1{next} NR==2{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){gsub(/"/,"",$i); x[i]=$i}; next} {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){gsub(/"/,"",$i); s[i]+=$i; ss[i]+=$i*$i}; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)for(j=i+1;j<=NF;j++){c[i,j]+=$i*$j}} END{n=NR-1; for(i=1;i<=5;i++)m[i]=s[i]/n; for(i=1;i<=5;i++){printf "%s mean %.5f sd %.5f\\n", "UYRDM"\\,i,m[i],sqrt((ss[i]-n*m[i]*m[i])/(n-1))}; print "CORR"; for(i=1;i<=5;i++){for(j=i+1;j<=5;j++){cov=(c[i,j]-n*m[i]*m[j])/(n-1); sd1=sqrt((ss[i]-n*m[i]*m[i])/(n-1));sd2=sqrt((ss[j]-n*m[j]*m[j])/(n-1)); printf "%s-%s %.5f\\n",substr("UYRDM",i,1),substr("UYRDM",j,1),cov/sd1/sd2}}}\' /app/bn_sample_10k.csv\ntrue', 'Enter']

["export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\ncat > /tmp/infer_bn.R <<'RS'\nx <- read.csv('/app/bn_sample_10k.csv'); vars <- names(x); n <- nrow(x); p <- length(vars)\n# Allowed directed edges: U cannot have parents.\npairs <- list();\nfor (i in 1:p) for (j in 1:p) if (i != j && j != 1) pairs[[length(pairs)+1]] <- c(i,j) # from i to j\nm <- length(pairs); best <- list(score=-Inf); count <- 0\nacyclic <- function(edges) {\n  adj <- matrix(FALSE,p,p)\n  if (length(edges)) for (e in edges) adj[e[1],e[2]] <- TRUE\n  state <- integer(p)\n  dfs <- function(v) { state[v] <<- 1; z <- which(adj[v,]); for (w in z) { if(state[w]==1) return(FALSE); if(state[w]==0 && !dfs(w)) return(FALSE) }; state[v] <<- 2; TRUE }\n  for(v in 1:p) if(state[v]==0 && !dfs(v)) return(FALSE); TRUE\n}\nlocal <- function(child, pars) {\n  y <- x[[child]]\n  if (!length(pars)) rss <- sum((y-mean(y))^2) else rss <- sum(lm(y ~ ., data=x[c(pars)])$residuals^2)\n  k <- length(pars)+2\n  -n/2*(log(2*pi)+1+log(rss/n)) - .5*k*log(n)\n}\n# recurse combinations of 6 edges\nchoose6 <- function(start, picked) {\n  left <- 6-length(picked); if (left==0) {\n    if(!acyclic(picked)) return()\n    count <<- count+1; pars <- vector('list',p); for(i in 1:p) pars[[i]] <- integer()\n    for(e in picked) pars[[e[2]]] <- c(pars[[e[2]]],e[1])\n    sc <- sum(sapply(1:p,function(j)local(j,pars[[j]])))\n    if(sc > best$score) best <<- list(score=sc, edges=picked, pars=pars)\n    return()\n  }\n  if(m-start+1 < left) return()\n  for(i in start:(m-left+1)) choose6(i+1,c(picked,list(pairs[[i]])))\n}\nchoose6(1,list()); cat('candidates',count,'best',best$score,'\\n')\nfor(e in best$edges) cat(vars[e[2]],',',vars[e[1]],'\\n',sep='')\ncat('parents\\n'); for(j in 1:p) cat(vars[j],':',paste(vars[best$pars[[j]]],collapse=','),'\\n')\nRS\nRscript /tmp/infer_bn.R\ntrue", 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/generate_bn.R <<\'PY\'\nimport os\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\ncontent = "set.seed(20260830)\\ndata <- read.csv(\'/app/bn_sample_10k.csv\', check.names=FALSE)\\nvars <- names(data)\\nif (!identical(vars, c(\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\'))) stop(\'Unexpected input columns\')\\n\\n# Maximum-likelihood Gaussian conditional regressions for the recovered DAG.\\nfit <- function(child, parents) {\\n  formula <- if (length(parents)) reformulate(parents, response=child) else as.formula(paste(child, \'~ 1\'))\\n  lm(formula, data=data)\\n}\\nmodels <- list(\\n  U=fit(\'U\', character()),\\n  Y=fit(\'Y\', \'U\'),\\n  R=fit(\'R\', \'U\'),\\n  D=fit(\'D\', c(\'U\',\'Y\')),\\n  M=fit(\'M\', c(\'U\',\'R\'))\\n)\\npredict_node <- function(model, newdata) as.numeric(predict(model, newdata=newdata)) + rnorm(nrow(newdata), 0, sigma(model))\\n\\nedges <- data.frame(to=c(\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\',\'D\',\'M\'), from=c(\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\'))\\nwrite.csv(edges, \'/app/learned_dag.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\nintervened_edges <- edges[edges$to != \'Y\', , drop=FALSE]\\nwrite.csv(intervened_edges, \'/app/intervened_dag.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\n\\n# Truncated factorization under do(Y=0): Y is fixed, so its incoming edge is removed.\\nout <- data.frame(\\n  U=predict_node(models$U, data.frame()),\\n  Y=0.0\\n)\\nout$R <- predict_node(models$R, out)\\nout$D <- predict_node(models$D, out)\\nout$M <- predict_node(models$M, out)\\nout <- out[, vars]\\nwrite.csv(out, \'/app/final_bn_sample.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\nRS\\nRscript /app/generate_bn.R\\nls -l /app/learned_dag.csv /app/intervened_dag.csv /app/final_bn_sample.csv"\ndir_path = os.path.dirname(path)\nif dir_path:\n    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n        f.write(content)\n    print(f"成功: 已写入 {path}")\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"写入失败: {exc}")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
["export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nif [ -f /app/generate_bn.R ]; then cat -- /app/generate_bn.R; else echo '错误: 找不到文件 /app/generate_bn.R'; fi\ntrue", 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/generate_bn.R <<\'PY\'\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\nold_str = "predict_node <- function(model, newdata) as.numeric(predict(model, newdata=newdata)) + rnorm(nrow(newdata), 0, sigma(model))\\n\\nedges <- data.frame(to=c(\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\',\'D\',\'M\'), from=c(\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\'))"\nnew_str = "n_samples <- 10000\\npredict_node <- function(model, newdata) {\\n  values <- as.numeric(predict(model, newdata=newdata))\\n  values + rnorm(nrow(newdata), 0, sigma(model))\\n}\\n\\nedges <- data.frame(to=c(\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\',\'D\',\'M\'), from=c(\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\'))"\n\ndef normalize_text(text: str) -> str:\n    text = text.replace(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\').replace(\'\\r\', \'\\n\')\n    return \'\\n\'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\'\\n\'))\n\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'r\', encoding=\'utf-8\', errors=\'replace\') as f:\n        content = f.read()\nexcept FileNotFoundError:\n    print(f"错误: 找不到文件 {path}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"修改失败: {exc}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\n\ncontent = normalize_text(content)\nold_str = normalize_text(old_str)\nnew_str = normalize_text(new_str)\ncount = content.count(old_str)\nif count == 0:\n    print("错误: 在文件中找不到 old_str。\\n建议：\\n1. 使用 read_file(raw_mode=True) 获取原始内容\\n2. 检查是否有多余的空格或换行符\\n3. 如果文件较大，考虑使用 write_full_file 全量覆盖")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nif count > 1:\n    print(f"错误: 匹配到 {count} 处相同的代码，请提供更具体的 old_str 以确保唯一性。")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nwith open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n    f.write(content.replace(old_str, new_str))\nprint(f"成功: 已更新 {path}。修改已持久化。")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/generate_bn.R <<\'PY\'\nimport os\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\ncontent = "set.seed(20260830)\\ndata <- read.csv(\'/app/bn_sample_10k.csv\', check.names=FALSE)\\nvars <- names(data)\\nif (!identical(vars, c(\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\'))) stop(\'Unexpected input columns\')\\nn_samples <- 10000\\n\\n# Fit one Gaussian conditional distribution for each node in the recovered DAG.\\nfit <- function(child, parents) {\\n  formula <- if (length(parents)) reformulate(parents, response=child) else as.formula(paste(child, \'~ 1\'))\\n  lm(formula, data=data)\\n}\\nmodels <- list(\\n  U=fit(\'U\', character()),\\n  Y=fit(\'Y\', \'U\'),\\n  R=fit(\'R\', \'U\'),\\n  D=fit(\'D\', c(\'U\',\'Y\')),\\n  M=fit(\'M\', c(\'U\',\'R\'))\\n)\\npredict_node <- function(model, newdata) {\\n  as.numeric(predict(model, newdata=newdata)) + rnorm(nrow(newdata), 0, sigma(model))\\n}\\n\\nedges <- data.frame(\\n  to=c(\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\',\'D\',\'M\'),\\n  from=c(\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\')\\n)\\nwrite.csv(edges, \'/app/learned_dag.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\n\\n# Under do(Y=0), remove the incoming edge to Y and retain all other factors.\\nintervened_edges <- edges[edges$to != \'Y\', , drop=FALSE]\\nwrite.csv(intervened_edges, \'/app/intervened_dag.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\n\\n# Generate in topological order using the truncated factorization.\\nout <- data.frame(U=rnorm(n_samples, coef(models$U)[1], sigma(models$U)))\\nout$Y <- 0.0\\nout$R <- predict_node(models$R, out)\\nout$D <- predict_node(models$D, out)\\nout$M <- predict_node(models$M, out)\\nout <- out[, vars]\\nwrite.csv(out, \'/app/final_bn_sample.csv\', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)\\n"\ndir_path = os.path.dirname(path)\nif dir_path:\n    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n        f.write(content)\n    print(f"成功: 已写入 {path}")\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"写入失败: {exc}")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nRscript /app/generate_bn.R\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/test_bn_outputs.R <<\'PY\'\nimport os\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\ncontent = "read_edges <- function(path) read.csv(path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)\\nedge_key <- function(e) paste(e$from, e$to, sep=\'->\')\\n\\nlearned <- read_edges(\'/app/learned_dag.csv\')\\nstopifnot(nrow(learned) == 6, identical(names(learned), c(\'to\',\'from\')))\\nstopifnot(!any(learned$to == \'U\'))\\nstopifnot(length(unique(edge_key(learned))) == 6)\\n\\n# A small DFS cycle check for the five-node graph.\\nvertices <- c(\'U\',\'Y\',\'R\',\'D\',\'M\')\\nadj <- lapply(vertices, function(v) learned$to[learned$from == v])\\nnames(adj) <- vertices\\nstate <- setNames(integer(length(vertices)), vertices)\\nvisit <- function(v) {\\n  state[v] <<- 1\\n  for (w in adj[[v]]) {\\n    stopifnot(state[w] != 1)\\n    if (state[w] == 0) visit(w)\\n  }\\n  state[v] <<- 2\\n}\\nfor (v in vertices) if (state[v] == 0) visit(v)\\n\\nintervened <- read_edges(\'/app/intervened_dag.csv\')\\nstopifnot(nrow(intervened) == 5)\\nstopifnot(setequal(edge_key(intervened), setdiff(edge_key(learned), \'U->Y\')))\\n\\nsample <- read.csv(\'/app/final_bn_sample.csv\', check.names=FALSE)\\nstopifnot(nrow(sample) == 10000, identical(names(sample), vertices))\\nstopifnot(all(sample$Y == 0), all(is.finite(as.matrix(sample))))\\nstopifnot(sd(sample$U) > 0, sd(sample$R) > 0, sd(sample$D) > 0, sd(sample$M) > 0)\\ncat(\'All Bayesian Network output checks passed\\\\n\')\\n"\ndir_path = os.path.dirname(path)\nif dir_path:\n    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n        f.write(content)\n    print(f"成功: 已写入 {path}")\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"写入失败: {exc}")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nRscript /app/test_bn_outputs.R\ntrue', 'Enter']
